department: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
benefit: You can get a bank loan of up to Rs 20 lakh for a small business that earns money (not farming). Shishu: up to Rs 50,000. Kishore: Rs 50,000 to Rs 5 lakh. Tarun: Rs 5 lakh to Rs 10 lakh. Tarun Plus: up to Rs 20 lakh if you repaid a Tarun loan well. There are no agents; apply yourself.

other: Individuals, shops, partnership firms and companies can apply.
You must not have failed to repay a bank loan before.
You may need the skills or experience for the business.

documents: ID proof (voter ID, driving licence, PAN, Aadhaar or passport)
Quotation for machinery or items you will buy
Proof of identity or address of your business
For loans above Shishu: bank statement for the last 6 months, and a project report
how_to_apply: Go to a bank branch, or apply online on the Udyamimitra portal. Pick New entrepreneur, Existing entrepreneur or Self-employed. Choose Shishu, Kishore or Tarun. Fill your business details and upload your papers. Keep the application number.
where_to_apply: Any bank, small finance bank, NBFC or MFI; or online on the Udyamimitra portal
